description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM HRM system, specifically for version 5.7.0. It includes methods to modify language strings, update data groups, create new tables, drop old tables, and insert error messages, implementing schema and data updates for this version.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for updating the HRM application's language strings, data groups, and schema structures to version 5.7.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration operations, including deletion, updates, creation of new tables, and data insertion.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string for this migration, which is '5.7.0'.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper for managing language strings.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the version of language strings in the database.

methods.name: deleteLangStringTranslationByLangStringUnitId
methods.description: Deletes translations associated with a specific language string unit ID and group ID.

methods.name: dropOldTables
methods.description: Drops obsolete tables from the database.

methods.name: insertI18NError
methods.description: Inserts predefined internationalization error messages into the database.

methods.name: deleteUnusedLangStrings
methods.description: Deletes a set of unused language strings based on predefined groups.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the entire migration process, including language string deletions, data group modifications, schema updates, and table creations.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the current migration version number as '5.7.0'.
